title: Practice 9: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я оделся, мы наперегонки ___ (сбежать / сбегать — to run down) к реке.
exercises.why: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)** — Divergent movement in various directions from one center. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «Без дороги».
exercises.context: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat..

exercises.q: Змеи ___ (расползаться — to crawl away) по комнате, окружали мальчика.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  From Александр Беляев, «Ариэль».
exercises.context: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**.

exercises.q: ___ (сводить / свести — to lead, to take) концы с концами, как знаешь.
exercises.why: **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Александр Островский, «Доходное место».
exercises.context: свести́** — **своди́ть — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together.

exercises.q: ___ (разбегаться / разбежаться — to take a run, to run up) по комнате.
exercises.why: **разбежа́ться** — **разбега́ться** — to scatter; to take a run, to run up (before jumping, diving, etc). **разнести́** — **разноси́ть** — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around. **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. **развезти́** — **развози́ть** — to deliver, to transport (multiple people or things to their respective destinations); (colloquial, impersonal). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Леонид Андреев, «Жизнь человека».
exercises.context: разбежа́ться** — **разбега́ться — to scatter; to take a run, to run up (before jumping, diving, etc).

exercises.context: разойти́сь** — **расходи́ться — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; to break up (of a crowd, meeting, etc.).

exercises.why: Он сходит вниз по лестнице. (b) to come off, to drive off: Автомобиль съехал с дороги. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Иван Тургенев, «Человек в серых очках».
